faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIBF Director (Training) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIBF Director (Training) position is 21 September 2026. Ensure you complete all steps before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Director (Training) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree, CA/CMA/CFA and CAIIB, MBA or equivalent qualification, or a Ph.D. in a Banking/Finance related topic.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Director (Training) position?
faq.answer: The age limit for this post is between a minimum of 55 years and a maximum of 62 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Director (Training) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 2,00,000/- per month, which is inclusive of all allowances.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Director (Training) post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of Director (Training) in the Indian Institute of Banking & Finance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this IIBF recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Director (Training) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Director (Training) position will primarily involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the IIBF located?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Banking & Finance is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400070.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Director (Training) position is on a contract basis.
